about:
Arkadia Plastics Inc operates from New Britain, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1996. The company is a custom compounding specialist focused on thermoplastic materials.

The company compounds customer-specified thermoplastic formulations and provides technical services including extrusion support, injection molding assistance, and moisture analysis. Its engineering team works with clients to develop customized material solutions, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Arkadia serves both medical and non-medical industries, supplying compounds tailored to each application. The quality control department furnishes required certificates for customer orders, and the sales team negotiates pricing on a project basis.

The firm emphasizes its identity as a service-oriented operation with deep compounding expertise, citing over 30 years of collective technical service experience. It offers technical support for both its own compounds and unrelated materials, positioning itself as a resource beyond simple material supply.
